title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1982-08-04
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. July 2016
source: AUD: Unknown mics > lead deck > Sony TC-D5 > Maxell UDXLII 90s. Recording by Jon Bernstein.

ai_review.summary: Mixed‑quality audience recording of a sweaty, long‑awaited show that fans loved despite the poor sound.
ai_review.review: The performance is described as “smoked” and super sweaty, rewarding fans who have waited decades to hear it. However, the recording itself is noted as not great quality – likely an audience taping with limited fidelity – which detracts from the listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers praise the musical energy but criticize the recording quality; weighted average yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is described as not great, muffled and difficult to capture; likely a tough taping environment resulting in low fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewer emphasizes overall high energy and crowd enthusiasm.
